doc.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: No agent or manager
summary: He never had an agent or other office job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Your day-to-day business of making career in music has mostly been of your own initiative? Did you ever have an agent or a manager doing any of that stuff for you?

No, never. Never. I don’t know why, no one ever approached me and I’ve never approached anyone. It’s been okay for me. I telephone. Call me by rep I suppose. It’s been good that way I really feel fortunate in that respect.
And you’ve never had to revert to an office type job?
Not after that first one. No I never have. Never did anything else man. I was very lucky there.
